summary: Count on from any number within 100, and count backward from any number within 20.
Know a penny is worth one cent and count pennies up to 20.
Use the commutative, associative and zero (identity) properties as strategies to add.
Know nickels and dimes as 5 and 10 pennies; find the value of pennies, nickels and dimes together.
Identify and compose regular and irregular flat shapes and compose solids, including spheres, into new shapes.
Recognize coins and know their values up to one dollar.
Solve word problems with dollar bills and coins, using the dollar and cent signs.
Multiply and divide fluently within 100; fluency with one-digit products, with recall from memory left to grade 4.
Find the value of a set of money written with a dollar sign and decimal point.
Read a multiplication equation as a comparison and write comparison statements as equations.
Know all products of two one-digit numbers from memory.
Add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers fluently with any algorithm, the standard one included.
Sort 2-D figures by parallel/perpendicular lines and angles; classify right, acute and obtuse triangles.
Use and explain parentheses in numerical expressions and evaluate them; brackets and braces are not listed.
Multiply multi-digit whole numbers fluently with any algorithm, the standard one included.
